Card Q&A.q: Ｗhen my opponent has ７ cards in their hand, this card’ｓ effect returned their Lv.4 or lower Digimon to their hand. Since they now have 8 or more cards, does the part of the effect after "Then, if your opponent has 8 or more cards in their hand" activate?

Effect: [Main] Return 2 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to their owners' hands. Then, if your opponent has 8 or more cards in their hand, return 1 of your opponent's level 6 or higher Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck.
